title: DiamondBorder
description: Simple. Fast. Controlled — redefine your world limits.
body:
DiamondBorder
Your world, your limits.
DiamondBorder is a lightweight and efficient world border controller plugin for Minecraft 1.21.x.
It lets you easily set, reset, and control world borders per world using simple commands — no confusing configs, no lag, just clean command control.


Features
✅ Simple one-command setup
✅ Works per-world (multiworld support)
✅ Enforces a minimum border size of 8x8
✅ Supports default Minecraft border reset
✅ Fully compatible with Spigot, Paper, and Purpur 1.21.x
✅ Permissions-based access for admins only
